description: Generated wiki shortcut wrappers; canonical behavior lives in workflows/.

wiki-ask.name: wiki-ask
wiki-ask.claude_description: Answer an ordinary question from the smallest relevant part of the wiki
wiki-ask.codex_description: Run the default lightweight wiki question workflow. Use for ordinary questions, comparisons, explanations, and lookups from the wiki unless the user explicitly invokes wiki-research.

wiki-capture.name: wiki-capture
wiki-capture.claude_description: Capture a decision or lived experience into the wiki
wiki-capture.codex_description: Run the wiki first-person capture workflow. Use when the user says $wiki-capture, wiki-capture, capture this decision, remember this experience, or wants a decision or lived experience saved into the wiki.

wiki-eval.name: wiki-eval
wiki-eval.claude_description: Run the wiki tooling eval workflow
wiki-eval.codex_description: Run the wiki tooling eval workflow. Use when the user says $wiki-eval, wiki-eval, run wiki evals, run the live evals, verify wiki guardrails, or wants to check that the wiki tools still work.

wiki-export.name: wiki-export
wiki-export.claude_description: Create a complete verified private backup of the local wiki tree
wiki-export.codex_description: Run the wiki export workflow. Use when the user says $wiki-export, wiki-export, export the wiki, back up the wiki, or wants a complete verified private backup.

wiki-ingest.name: wiki-ingest
wiki-ingest.claude_description: Ingest a new source from raw/ into the wiki
wiki-ingest.codex_description: Run the wiki ingest workflow. Use when the user says $wiki-ingest, wiki-ingest, ingest a source, drop into raw and ingest, or wants a raw artifact turned into wiki pages.

wiki-lint.name: wiki-lint
wiki-lint.claude_description: Lint the wiki, including deterministic checks, judgment candidates, and the verifier evidence check
wiki-lint.codex_description: Run the wiki lint workflow, including its verifier-agent evidence check. Use when the user says $wiki-lint, wiki-lint, lint the wiki, run lint, or wants deterministic and judgment-oriented wiki checks.

wiki-promote.name: wiki-promote
wiki-promote.claude_description: Route a useful artifact to the right durable wiki home
wiki-promote.codex_description: Run the wiki artifact-promotion router. Use when the user says $wiki-promote, wiki-promote, promote, save this artifact, file this, or asks where a useful output belongs in the wiki.

wiki-research.name: wiki-research
wiki-research.claude_description: Run manually invoked wiki research with claim-level independent verification
wiki-research.codex_description: Run the manual high-rigor wiki research workflow with claim-level independent verification. Use only when the user explicitly says $wiki-research, wiki-research, or /wiki-research.

wiki-setup.name: wiki-setup
wiki-setup.claude_description: Configure wiki/domain.md and offer optional GitHub and private-backup connection help
wiki-setup.codex_description: Run the initial wiki setup interview. Use when the user says $wiki-setup, wiki-setup, or setup in a fresh clone and wants to configure the context name, scope, and example questions, with optional GitHub and private-backup connection help after domain setup.

wiki-synthesize.name: wiki-synthesize
wiki-synthesize.claude_description: Run a memo-first synthesis pass that surfaces corpus distillation candidates for review
wiki-synthesize.codex_description: Run the wiki synthesis workflow. Use when the user says $wiki-synthesize, wiki-synthesize, synthesize the wiki, run synthesis, or wants a corpus distillation pass.
